LinksMenu.Name: Module Support
LinksMenu.Label: Links
LinksMenu.Hint: Open BM5E documentation, issue tracker, and support links.
LinksMenu.Title: Resources & Support
LinksMenu.SupportMessage: Toss a Coin to your Bugbear

IntegratedDamageModifiers.Name: Integrated Damage Modifiers
IntegratedDamageModifiers.Hint: Choose which D&D 5e damage modifiers BM5E automates independently of Mutable Damage Calculation.

ChatDoubleClick.Name: Enable chat document double-clicks
ChatDoubleClick.Hint: Double-click document icons and names in chat messages to open their sheets or images.

MutableDamageCalculation.Name: Mutable Damage Calculation
MutableDamageCalculation.Hint: Adds D&D 5e mutable damage-calculation hooks required by automations such as Undead Fortitude. Requires libWrapper and reloads the world when changed.
MutableDamageCalculation.LibWrapperRequired: BM5E mutable damage calculation requires libWrapper to be enabled.

Features.Name: Integrated Damage Features
Features.Hint: Choose which D&D 5e features BM5E automates during damage calculation.

Enabled.Name: Enable damage restoration
Enabled.Hint: Record native D&D5e damage applications and add a Restore button to the damage tray.

EffectApplicationOutcomes.Name: Deselect effect targets by roll outcome
EffectApplicationOutcomes.Hint: Automatically deselect missed attack targets and targets that succeed on saving throws from effect application trays.

Switch.Name: Enable Status HUD Sorting
Switch.Hint: When enabled, the status effects labels will also be shown and an opinionated sorting will take place!

SortingType.Name: Status Effects sorting
SortingType.Hint: Fill by rows (left -> right) or by columns (top -> bottom)

NumberColumns.Name: Number of columns
NumberColumns.Hint: Divide the HUD status effects number into this number of columns

Scale.Name: HUD scale
Scale.Hint: Scale the Status HUD as a percentage of its default size.

ScaleEnabled.Name: Enable HUD scaling
ScaleEnabled.Hint: Scale the Status HUD and compensate for canvas zoom.

Filter.Name: Enable status filter
Filter.Hint: Show or hide the status filter input on the Token HUD.

AutoRollDamage.Name: Auto Roll Damage
AutoRollDamage.Hint: Automatically roll damage when an attack is successful.
AutoRollDamage.Prompt: You have already rolled damage for this attack. What do you want to do? Close dialog to cancel!

AutoPopout.Name: Enable use message pop-outs
AutoPopout.Hint: Automatically pop out usage messages for configured defaults, manually enabled activities, and extra attacks.

Identifiers.Name: Auto pop-out use messages
Identifiers.Label: Configure
Identifiers.Hint: Configure items and activities whose use messages should pop out by default.
Identifiers.Title: Auto Pop-out Use Messages
Identifiers.HintText: Enter an item or activity name, id, identifier, or UUID, or an actor UUID, id, or name. You can also drag a compendium document here. Activity Behavior settings override these defaults.
Identifiers.ImportFailed: The selected file is not a valid use message pop-out defaults export.
Identifiers.ExtraAttackHint: Match a Feature on the actor. Its melee and ranged weapon attacks will pop out.

Activity.Name: Use message pop-out
Activity.Hint: Bugbear's Mechanics 5e addition. Pop out the usage message for reusing it as needed. Helpful for extra attacks, Spirit Guardians quick use, etc.

ChatMessagesTooltips.Name: Show roll results on message buttons
ChatMessagesTooltips.Hint: When enabled, the Attack and Damage buttons in chat messages will show roll results.

EffectsEditor.Title: BM5E Effect Editor
EffectsEditor.AttributeKeyHint: For BM5E overtime details, open the local README.

Readme.MissingDocument: BM5E README document was not found.
Readme.MissingPack: BM5E README pack was not found: {pack}

EffectsEditor.ActivitySourceHint: Create an activity on this effect's Item, or on the actor's BM5E Overtime Item for actor-owned effects.
EffectsEditor.PreserveDCHint: Resolve the linked activity's DC using its source actor before creating the overtime activity.
EffectsEditor.NoActivityParent: BM5E could not find an item to create the overtime activity on.
EffectsEditor.GeneratedValueHint: Preview of the overtime value generated from the editor fields.

Enabled.Name: Enable enchantment handling
Enabled.Hint: Enable Bugbear's Mechanics 5e enchantment chat-card handling and stackable enchantments.

Stackable.Name: Allow enchantment stacks
Stackable.Hint: Bugbear's Mechanics 5e addition. Allow this enchantment to be applied to the same item more than once.

MaximumItems.Name: Maximum enchanted items
MaximumItems.Hint: Bugbear's Mechanics 5e addition. The number of different items this enchantment can affect at once. Defaults to 1. Use 0 for unlimited.
MaximumItems.Reached: This enchantment has reached its maximum number of enchanted items.

Enchantment.Unauthorized: Only the target owner or the enchantment user can apply this enchantment.
